data.comparison_scope: Free plans (or free tiers) of eight uptime-monitoring services; intervals are the shortest interval stated for the free tier.

services.name: UptimeRobot
services.notes: The pricing page also limits the free tier to five integrations; SMS/voice credits may not renew on free.

services.name: Better Stack (Better Uptime)
services.notes: The free tier is described as free for personal projects.

services.name: StatusCake
alert_channels: Integrations (not enumerated on the free-plan row)
services.notes: The current pricing table says free alerts are through integrations; it does not establish a specific free integration or email channel.

services.name: HetrixTools
services.notes: Phone/SMS capability is included, but the free plan does not include recurring phone/SMS credits.

services.name: Freshping
services.notes: These figures come from Freshworks' official launch announcement; a current Freshping pricing page was not available in the fetched sources, so treat this row as potentially stale.

message: Collected a side-by-side comparison of eight free uptime-monitoring tiers. Freshping's row is flagged because the available official source is a launch announcement rather than a current pricing page; StatusCake's free alert channel is only specified as integrations, without named integrations.

suggestions.label: Filter to SaaS services with current pricing pages
suggestions.prompt: Which of these services have a currently published free plan rather than a historical or ambiguous free tier?

suggestions.label: Compare alert coverage
suggestions.prompt: Which free plans support Slack, SMS, webhooks, or phone calls without paid upgrades?
